got {1}: {2}\\\".format(\\n target, response.status_code, response.text[:200]\\n )\\n )\\n assert_error(response)\\n\\n\\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\\\"target\\\", BLOCKED)\\ndef test_a_private_or_link_local_literal_leaves_no_row(app, target):\\n app.create(target)\\n\\n assert app.link_rows() == [], \\\"a blocked destination reached the database\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef test_the_cloud_metadata_address_is_rejected_with_the_blocked_destination_code(app, assert_error):\\n response = app.create(\\\"http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/\\\")\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 400, response.text[:200]\\n assert assert_error(response)[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"blocked_destination\\\"\\n assert app.link_rows() == []\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_hostname_resolving_to_the_metadata_address_is_rejected(app, fake_dns, assert_error):\\n fake_dns.set(\\\"metadata.internal.test\\\", [\\\"169.254.169.254\\\"])\\n\\n response = app.create(\\\"http://metadata.internal.test/latest/meta-data/\\\")\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 400, response.text[:200]\\n assert assert_error(response)[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"blocked_destination\\\"\\n assert app.link_rows() == []\\n assert \\\"metadata.internal.test\\\" in fake_dns.lookups, (\\n \\\"the host was never resolved, so it cannot have been denylist checked\\\"\\n )\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_hostname_resolving_to_loopback_is_rejected_and_leaves_no_row(app, fake_dns, assert_error):\\n fake_dns.set(\\\"sneaky.test\\\", [\\\"127.0.0.1\\\"])\\n\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://sneaky.test/x\\\")\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 400, response.text[:200]\\n assert assert_error(response)[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"blocked_destination\\\"\\n assert app.link_rows() == []\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_hostname_with_one_private_address_among_public_ones_is_rejected(app, fake_dns):\\n fake_dns.set(\\\"mixed.test\\\", [\\\"93.184.216.34\\\", \\\"10.0.0.5\\\"])\\n\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://mixed.test/x\\\")\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 400, response.text[:200]\\n assert app.link_rows() == []\\n\\n\\ndef test_public_destinations_are_still_accepted_so_the_filter_is_not_deny_everything(app, fake_dns):\\n fake_dns.set(\\\"good.test\\\", [\\\"93.184.216.34\\\"])\\n\\n literal = app.create(\\\"http://93.184.216.34/x\\\")\\n named = app.create(\\\"https://good.test/x\\\")\\n\\n assert literal.status_code == 201, literal.text[:200]\\n assert named.status_code == 201, named.text[:200]\\n assert app.count_links() == 2\\n\"},{\"path\":\"tests_pipeline/test_link_expiry_behaviour.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Expiry, controlled by writing the stored expiry -- never by sleeping.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nfrom datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone\\n\\nimport pytest\\n\\n\\ndef _past(seconds=5):\\n return datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(seconds=seconds)\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_link_whose_expiry_has_passed_no_longer_redirects(app, assert_error):\\n code = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/gone\\\").json()[\\\"code\\\"]\\n app.set_expiry(code, _past())\\n\\n response = app.visit(code)\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 410, (\\n \\\"an expired link must not redirect; got {0}: {1}\\\".format(\\n response.status_code, response.text[:200]\\n )\\n )\\n assert assert_error(response)[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"link_expired\\\"\\n assert \\\"location\\\" not in set(k.lower() for k in response.headers.keys()), (\\n \\\"an expired link must not still hand out a Location header\\\"\\n )\\n\\n\\ndef test_visiting_an_expired_link_records_no_click(app):\\n code = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/gone\\\").json()[\\\"code\\\"]\\n app.set_expiry(code, _past(3600))\\n\\n for _ in range(3):\\n assert app.visit(code).status_code == 410\\n\\n assert app.click_rows() == [], \\\"a refused redirect was counted as a click\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_link_whose_expiry_is_still_ahead_redirects_normally(app):\\n code = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/live\\\").json()[\\\"code\\\"]\\n app.set_expiry(code, datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=1))\\n\\n response = app.visit(code)\\n\\n assert response.status_code == 307, response.text[:200]\\n assert response.headers[\\\"location\\\"] == \\\"https://example.com/live\\\"\\n\\n\\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\\n \\\"value\\\",\\n [\\\"2000-01-01T00:00:00Z\\\", \\\"1999-12-31T23:59:59.999999Z\\\"],\\n ids=[\\\"millennium\\\", \\\"just_before\\\"],\\n)\\ndef test_creating_a_link_with_an_expiry_in_the_past_is_refused_and_stores_nothing(\\n app, assert_error, value\\n):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/a\\\", expires_at=value)\\n\\n assert response.status_code in (400, 422), (value, response.text[:200])\\n assert_error(response)\\n assert app.link_rows() == []\\n\\n\\ndef test_an_expired_link_still_reports_the_clicks_it_collected_while_live(app):\\n code = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/gone\\\").json()[\\\"code\\\"]\\n assert app.visit(code).status_code == 307\\n app.set_expiry(code, _past(60))\\n\\n assert app.visit(code).status_code == 410\\n stats = app.stats(code)\\n\\n assert stats.status_code == 200, stats.text[:200]\\n body = stats.json()\\n assert body[\\\"code\\\"] == code\\n assert body[\\\"total_clicks\\\"] == 1, (\\n \\\"the live click must survive expiry and the 410 must not be counted\\\"\\n )\\n\"},{\"path\":\"tests_pipeline/test_per_ip_rate_limit.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Per-IP creation limiting: 429 past the limit, per key, and window bounded.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nCALLER = \\\"203.0.113.10\\\"\\nOTHER = \\\"198.51.100.7\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef _limited(app_factory, **extra):\\n return app_factory(\\n LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=\\\"true\\\", LINKS_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR=\\\"true\\\", **extra\\n )\\n\\n\\ndef test_the_eleventh_unkeyed_creation_from_one_address_is_refused_with_429(app_factory, assert_error):\\n app = _limited(app_factory)\\n\\n for i in range(10):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), xff=CALLER)\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.status_code, response.text[:200])\\n\\n blocked = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/eleven\\\", xff=CALLER)\\n\\n assert blocked.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"the 11th creation in the window must be refused, got {0}: {1}\\\".format(\\n blocked.status_code, blocked.text[:200]\\n )\\n )\\n error = assert_error(blocked)\\n assert error[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"rate_limited\\\", error\\n retry_after = blocked.headers.get(\\\"retry-after\\\")\\n assert retry_after is not None, \\\"a 429 must carry Retry-After\\\"\\n assert 1 <= int(retry_after) <= 60, retry_after\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_throttled_creation_writes_no_row(app_factory):\\n app = _limited(app_factory)\\n for i in range(10):\\n app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), xff=CALLER)\\n\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/eleven\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 429\\n\\n assert app.count_links() == 10, \\\"the refused request still created a link\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef test_another_client_address_still_succeeds_after_the_first_is_throttled(app_factory):\\n app = _limited(app_factory)\\n for i in range(10):\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), xff=CALLER).status_code == 201\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/over\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 429\\n\\n other = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/other\\\", xff=OTHER)\\n\\n assert other.status_code == 201, (\\n \\\"the limit must be per caller, not global: \\\" + other.text[:200]\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 11\\n\\n\\ndef test_links_rate_limit_max_is_read_from_the_environment(app_factory):\\n app = _limited(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"2\\\")\\n\\n first = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/1\\\", xff=CALLER)\\n second = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/2\\\", xff=CALLER)\\n third = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/3\\\", xff=CALLER)\\n\\n assert (first.status_code, second.status_code) == (201, 201)\\n assert third.status_code == 429, third.text[:200]\\n assert app.count_links() == 2\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_throttled_address_may_create_again_once_the_window_has_advanced(app_factory, fake_clock):\\n app = _limited(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"2\\\")\\n clock = fake_clock(app)\\n assert clock.installed, (\\n \\\"the limiter's clock is not substitutable; the design requires \\\"\\n \\\"app.state.rate_limiter.clock so windows can be advanced without sleeping\\\"\\n )\\n\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/1\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 201\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/2\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 201\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/3\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 429\\n\\n clock.advance(61)\\n after = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/4\\\", xff=CALLER)\\n\\n assert after.status_code == 201, (\\n \\\"the window is 60s; after 61 simulated seconds the caller must be served \\\"\\n \\\"again, got {0}: {1}\\\".format(after.status_code, after.text[:200])\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 3\\n\\n\\ndef test_redirects_and_stats_are_never_refused_by_the_creation_limit(app_factory):\\n app = _limited(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"1\\\")\\n code = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/a\\\", xff=CALLER).json()[\\\"code\\\"]\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/b\\\", xff=CALLER).status_code == 429\\n\\n for _ in range(5):\\n assert app.visit(code, xff=CALLER).status_code == 307\\n assert app.stats(code).status_code == 200\\n assert app.health().status_code == 200\\n\\n\\ndef test_disabling_the_limiter_removes_every_429(app_factory):\\n app = app_factory(LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=\\\"false\\\", LINKS_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR=\\\"true\\\")\\n\\n for i in range(15):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), xff=CALLER)\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.text[:200])\\n\\n assert app.count_links() == 15\\n\"},{\"path\":\"tests_pipeline/test_api_key_quota_limits.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Per-API-key quotas from SHORTENER_API_KEYS.\\n\\nEvery test drives POST /api/links through the HTTP surface against its own\\ndatabase and its own freshly started application, so the startup-only key table\\nis rebuilt each time.\\n\\\"\\\"\\\"\\nALPHA_BETA = \\\"alpha:100,beta:20\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef _keyed(app_factory, keys=ALPHA_BETA, **extra):\\n return app_factory(\\n SHORTENER_API_KEYS=keys, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=\\\"true\\\", **extra\\n )\\n\\n\\ndef test_one_hundred_alpha_keyed_creations_succeed_and_the_hundred_and_first_is_429(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\")\\n\\n for i in range(100):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/a{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (\\n \\\"keyed creation {0} of quota 100 was refused with {1}: {2}\\\".format(\\n i + 1, response.status_code, response.text[:200]\\n )\\n )\\n\\n over = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/over\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n\\n assert over.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"the 101st alpha creation must exceed the quota, got {0}\\\".format(over.status_code)\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 100\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_quota_429_carries_the_rate_limited_envelope_retry_after_and_no_store(app_factory, assert_error):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, keys=\\\"alpha:2\\\", LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"50\\\")\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/1\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\").status_code == 201\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/2\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\").status_code == 201\\n\\n refused = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/3\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n\\n assert refused.status_code == 429, refused.text[:200]\\n error = assert_error(refused)\\n assert error[\\\"code\\\"] == \\\"rate_limited\\\", error\\n retry_after = refused.headers.get(\\\"retry-after\\\")\\n assert retry_after is not None, \\\"a quota 429 must carry Retry-After\\\"\\n assert 1 <= int(retry_after) <= 60, retry_after\\n assert \\\"no-store\\\" in refused.headers.get(\\\"cache-control\\\", \\\"\\\").lower(), (\\n repr(refused.headers.get(\\\"cache-control\\\"))\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 2, \\\"the refused keyed request wrote a row\\\"\\n\\n\\ndef test_beta_gets_its_own_smaller_quota_of_twenty(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\")\\n\\n for i in range(20):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/b{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"beta\\\")\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.status_code, response.text[:200])\\n\\n over = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/b-over\\\", key=\\\"beta\\\")\\n\\n assert over.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"beta's quota is 20, the 21st must be refused, got {0}\\\".format(over.status_code)\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 20\\n\\n\\ndef test_one_exhausted_key_does_not_throttle_a_different_key(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, keys=\\\"alpha:2,beta:3\\\", LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"50\\\")\\n app.create(\\\"https://example.com/1\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n app.create(\\\"https://example.com/2\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n assert app.create(\\\"https://example.com/3\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\").status_code == 429\\n\\n other = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/4\\\", key=\\\"beta\\\")\\n\\n assert other.status_code == 201, (\\n \\\"beta has its own counter and must still be served: \\\" + other.text[:200]\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 3\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_known_key_is_bounded_by_its_quota_and_not_also_by_the_per_ip_limit(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\")\\n\\n statuses = [\\n app.create(\\\"https://example.com/k{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"alpha\\\").status_code\\n for i in range(11)\\n ]\\n\\n assert statuses == [201] * 11, (\\n \\\"a recognised key must use its quota instead of, not in addition to, \\\"\\n \\\"LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX: \\\" + repr(statuses)\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 11\\n\\n\\ndef test_a_keys_counter_is_shared_across_client_addresses(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(\\n app_factory,\\n keys=\\\"alpha:3\\\",\\n LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"50\\\",\\n LINKS_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR=\\\"true\\\",\\n )\\n\\n for i in range(3):\\n response = app.create(\\n \\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"alpha\\\", xff=\\\"203.0.113.10\\\"\\n )\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.text[:200])\\n\\n from_elsewhere = app.create(\\n \\\"https://example.com/4\\\", key=\\\"alpha\\\", xff=\\\"198.51.100.7\\\"\\n )\\n\\n assert from_elsewhere.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"one key must not buy extra allowance by moving to another address, got \\\"\\n \\\"{0}\\\".format(from_elsewhere.status_code)\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 3\\n\\n\\ndef test_an_unknown_key_shares_the_per_ip_bucket_with_unkeyed_traffic(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\")\\n\\n for i in range(10):\\n key = \\\"gamma\\\" if i % 2 else None\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), key=key)\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.status_code, response.text[:200])\\n\\n over = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/eleven\\\", key=\\\"gamma\\\")\\n\\n assert over.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"an unrecognised key must not create a fresh allowance, got {0}\\\".format(\\n over.status_code\\n )\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 10\\n\\n\\ndef test_key_matching_is_case_sensitive_so_upper_case_alpha_is_unknown(app_factory):\\n app = _keyed(app_factory, LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\")\\n\\n for i in range(10):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"ALPHA\\\")\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, response.text[:200])\\n\\n over = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/eleven\\\", key=\\\"ALPHA\\\")\\n\\n assert over.status_code == 429, (\\n \\\"ALPHA is not alpha and must fall back to the per-IP limit of 10, got \\\"\\n \\\"{0}\\\".format(over.status_code)\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 10\\n\\n\\ndef test_an_empty_or_whitespace_key_header_is_treated_as_no_key(app_factory):\\n app == 429, (\\n \\\"a blank key must fall back to the per-IP bucket, got {0}\\\".format(\\n over.status_code\\n )\\n )\\n assert app.count_links() == 10\\n\\n\\ndef test_with_shortener_api_keys_unset_the_header_changes_nothing(app_factory):\\n app = app_factory(\\n SHORTENER_API_KEYS=None,\\n LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=\\\"true\\\",\\n LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=\\\"10\\\",\\n )\\n\\n for i in range(10):\\n response = app.create(\\\"https://example.com/{0}\\\".format(i), key=\\\"alpha\\\")\\n assert response.status_code == 201, (i, Fresh SQLite file + freshly imported application module per test (startup-only SHORTENER_API_KEYS is re-parsed, limiter state starts empty); a stub resolver replaces socket.getaddrinfo so nothing touches the network; time is never slept, only advanced through a substituted limiter clock.\\n\\nMandated coverage: round trip -> test_link_round_trip_contract.py (201 body, exact 307, exact Location, Cache-Control: no-store, LINKS_BASE_URL trailing-slash stripping). Open redirect -> test_open_redirect_scheme_rejection.py (javascript:/data:/file: get 4xx with error envelope, unsupported_scheme, and a separate test proving zero rows exist, plus a CRLF-injection URL). Private/link-local -> test_private_network_target_rejection.py (169.254.169.254, 127.0.0.1, 10/172.16/192.168, ::1, fd00::, 0.0.0.0, hostnames resolving to metadata/loopback/mixed, plus a public positive control so 'deny everything' fails). Expiry -> test_link_expiry_behaviour.py (expiry rewritten into the past in the DB; no sleeps). Rate limit -> test_per_ip_rate_limit.py (11th unkeyed request 429 + Retry-After + no row; a second address still 201; LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX honoured; window advance via fake clock; redirects/stats/health never throttled; LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false). Collision -> test_short_code_collision_retry.py (generator forced to return an existing code once/twice/three times; asserts retry happened, unique code, both links still resolve, never 500; the stub falls back to random codes after the queue drains so an infinite-retry implementation cannot hang the suite). Unknown code -> test_unknown_code_handling.py (404 not_found, zero links, zero clicks, malformed codes). Click analytics -> test_click_analytics_counting.py (+1 per 307, no increment on 404 or on a refused expired redirect, per-link attribution, count readable synchronously).\\n\\nAcceptance criteria for SHORTENER_API_KEYS -> test_api_key_quota_limits.py: 100 alpha creations then 429; 429 envelope/Retry-After 1..60/Cache-Control no-store/no row; beta quota 20 with 21st 429; independence of alpha and beta counters; 11 keyed creations under LINKS_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10 (exclusive substitution); one key's counter shared across X-Forwarded-For addresses; unknown key shares the per-IP bucket; ALPHA vs alpha case sensitivity; empty/whitespace header treated as absent; SHORTENER_API_KEYS unset behaves as today; malformed entries dropped while epsilon:12 works; whitespace stripping in ' alpha : 100 , beta:20 '; duplicate key last-wins (9 not 5); window advance restores a throttled key; redirects and stats/health unaffected by a spent quota; limiter disabled -> 15 keyed + 15 unkeyed all 201. test_surface_invariants.py covers no schema change, no extra table, OpenAPI paths exactly {/health, /api/links, /api/links/{code}/stats} plus the unlisted /{code}, and that the raw key appears in no file under the DB directory (incl. WAL), no log record and no response body.\\n\\nDesign vs implementation mismatches (findings, tests follow the implementation as instructed):\\n1. Expired links: the design says GET /{code} must return 404 not_found, indistinguishable from an unknown code, to avoid an enumeration oracle. The implementation returns 410 with error code link_expired. Tests assert 410/link_expired. This is a real deviation from the stated security decision.\\n2. Data model names: the design specifies links.target_url and clicks(code, clicked_at); the implementation uses links.url and clicks(id, link_id, clicked_at, referrer, user_agent). The 'no schema change' test pins the implementation's columns.\\n3. Limiter internals: the design pins app.state.rate_limiter.clock as the substitution point and a fixed-window counter with per-IP and per-key maps; the implementation uses a sliding-window deque inside the middleware with no exposed clock and no key awareness at all (app/ratelimit.py never reads X-API-Key and app/config.py never reads SHORTENER_API_KEYS). The clock fixture prefers .clock and falls back to shimming the limiter module's time module; the window tests assert a clock was actually installed. Every keyed-quota test will fail against the code as shown, which is the point: the feature is unimplemented there.\\n4. The implementation reads several env vars not in the design's configuration list (LINKS_DEFAULT_TTL_DAYS, LINKS_MAX_URL_LENGTH, LINKS_CODE_LENGTH, LINKS_CODE_MAX_ATTEMPTS, LINKS_STATS_*, LINKS_DNS_RESOLUTION_ENABLED, LINKS_LOG_LEVEL). These tests set none of them; DNS is neutralised at the socket layer instead, so behaviour is pinned only against design-sanctioned names.\\n\\nDeliberately not covered here: default TTL length, max URL length, stats pagination bounds, health degradation, log redaction of client IPs, code entropy/statistics, and the design's stats 'expired=true' field (the implementation exposes no such field) - the pre-existing tests/ suite covers most of these.\"}", "tier": "deep"}
